newsitem.title: FRANCE: French CNPF members see stable sales in 1997 H1.
newsitem.headline: French CNPF members see stable sales in 1997 H1.

text.p: A majority of companies in the CNPF French employers federation expect stable or increased sales in the first half of 1997, a report from its economic committee said on Friday.
Some 42 percent of organisations polled expect stable sales in the first six months, with 33 percent looking for an improvement, and 22 percent forecasting a decrease.
"The general tone is that of a search for consolidation of growth in the coming months," committee chairman Denis Kessler wrote in a letter with the report.
Around 51 percent expect lower margins, 43 expect stability and only four forecast an increase.
Asked what economic policy was needed to reinvigorate growth, 51 percent called for reduced public spending and lighter social charges and taxes.
